reviews.author: Daniel Ferra
reviews.text: Highly recommend Cliff Parrish Heating & Cooling! I reached out with an AC issue on the same day we brought our newborn home, and Cliff went above and beyond to help us get everything taken care of. He was extremely knowledgeable, professional, and genuinely cared about making sure my family was comfortable. He even followed up with me later that evening to make sure everything was still working properly. Great customer service and an even better person. Cliff definitely earned my business going forward. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Dan West
reviews.text: If I could give Cliff Parrish Heating & Cooling Services a 100-star rating, I would ! My HVAC system quit cooling and in less than 12-hours it was repaired and cooling like brand new ! Cliff was very responsive, professional, and genuinely cared. Called Cliff on a recommendation from TWO of my neighbors who use CPH&CS on a Thursday evening, the very next morning-Preston Barnette (technician) was at my home, diagnosed the issue, and had it repaired in less than one hour ! You can NOT beat the service, customer service, and prices ANYWHERE ! I had originally called a name private equity HVAC repair company-I'm so glad Cliff actually called me back, because you can't beat that kind of service and pricing. I highly recommend Cliff Parrish Heating & Cooling for ANY HVAC issues you may have. They definitely have me as a customer for life !

reviews.author: Riley Hottovy
reviews.text: Cliff and his team are exactly what you want when you're dealing with hvac issues. Not only did Cliff readily come to my house and walk me through what the issue was with my system - he showed me the other parts of my system and told me how I could improve them myself to save some money. I initially called Cliff to have him replace my unit. I figured it was an old unit (~25 years old) and it hasn't been replaced and we were servicing it constantly. Instead of trying to sell me a unit, Cliff diagnosed what was wrong and fixed it. I've used other local HVAC companies and they've always defaulted to selling me a new unit. It'd be hard to find a better HVAC company than Cliff and his team and I'd recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Melissa Rock
reviews.text: My AC unit stopped working in the middle of this horribly hot summer. A friend recommended that I reach out to Cliff. They responded immediately. Was beyond kind and helpful, and was ready to come same day to get it fixed. They worked with my schedule and were super professional. If I could give them more than 5 stars, I would. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Lola Davis
reviews.text: Thank God for Clif Parrish heating and cooling service. I know what it's like now to receive quality, timely, professional services from a company that cares about their customers. Initially upon scheduling, I had a good feeling about the confidence I heard over the phone. I was right what was expressed to me was reflected in the excellent service I received. I would definitely recommend Parrish Heating and cooling to all customers seeking a honest reputable business.

reviews.author: ammon young
reviews.text: Cliff and the Technicians are top notch! I’m a licensed home inspector and work alongside various types of contractors on a regular basis. Cliff and crew are very honest, knowledgeable and happy to educate customers. They responded to my Sunday afternoon call within minutes and took care of the non-emergency job first thing the next morning. I look forward to a long relationship with this HVAC company and will happily refer those in need to them. Thanks Cliff (and Ronnie)!

reviews.author: Ora Rehm
reviews.text: This company is family owned Cliff and his guys are trustworthy and they do quality work..I had a problem Friday evening and then came in an hour and added Freon and we where very happy with air .. Yoy will not regret them as your company..

reviews.author: matt garon
reviews.text: Cliff and his Technicians are the very best. They always show up on time and contact you if for any reason they are going to be late (very rare). They explain exactly what they will be doing on your system and do the work in a timely manor. Cliff is always available for a quick call or for an emergence service call. They are truly a top notch outfit. So lucky to have them as my HVAC Service provider!!

reviews.author: Tucker Goodman
reviews.text: Google doesn’t have enough room or time for my glowing review so here is the most condensed version I can give. Cliff and his crew are on another level. They replaced an entire HVAC system for me…as a result of months long issues with other companies, the original install and on and on. His team was beyond professional and knowledgeable. Everything about the job from initial consultation to continued communication to the final result was of the highest caliber. Cliff Parrish and his team get my highest praise and recommendation.

reviews.author: Brandon Johnson
reviews.text: Cliff and his team are awesome. They do emergency service calls, new installs, and service agreements. They always work with you and provide the correct solution at a fair price. A local hvac company in Johnston County that has been around for years. We appreciate everything Cliff has done for us. Recommended, Trustworthy, and always on time! A+++

reviews.author: Kim Bunch
reviews.text: First time using this service. So fortunate to call and have a technician come the same day. Very professional and couldn't ask for a nicer gentleman.

reviews.author: Tyler Trotter
reviews.text: These Guys are probably the most Honest in the business. I have my Father to thank for Sending me To Cliff and Co., and I really appreciate what they did, especially since I'm young and new to Being an adult. These guys didn't screw us like most of the companies we were talking to, Such as Rescue Rooter. Thank you for Everything! Thank you for Saving My Bank Account! My Dog Thanks you Too.

reviews.author: Jonathan F
reviews.text: Great service, he came out the same day . He was friendly, knowledgeable and reasonably priced. Glad to have found this company! We will definitely use him again if we have any other issues.

reviews.author: AnneMarie Wilson
reviews.text: My heat went out, I have my 83 year old mother living with me. I got a recommendation from a neighbor. Best people ever. They showed up first thing Monday morning. The young men were extremely professional, knew what they were doing and had it fixed quickly and thank goodness it wasn't expensive. I was so relieved. I will definitely use them again and recommend them to my friends.

reviews.author: Logan Boykin Blackwell
reviews.text: I can't say enough about how much I appreciate these guys! They are great to work with. It can be intimidating reaching out and not knowing anything about what you need done, but they make you feel comfortable & are happy to answer any questions. They provide fast and honest service & I can't recommend them enough!

reviews.author: Kimberly Hall
reviews.text: Cliff and his guys are absolutely amazing. Very helpful and friendly. Fair pricing and quick response times. Couldn't recommend them more.

reviews.author: Tim Roof
reviews.text: I contacted this gentleman needing ac replacement after being told it would be 7-12 k. And no window in sight. Needless to say this is for my 80 year old mom. This guy Cliff had a brandnew system installed the next day and went above and beyond. My Mom is happy and so am I. And less the 7k also!!

reviews.author: morgan halvorsen
reviews.text: We had a problem with our heat and they were out here in an hour to fix it! Great customer service and fixed the problem fast! Couldn’t reccomend them enough!

reviews.author: Shannon Woodall
reviews.text: We scheduled the appointment and they showed up on time. Our ac was fixed quickly. This company is very responsive and professional. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: josh gibson
reviews.text: Awesome service, friendly detailed people, very personable and professional!! Price was just right!! Highly recommend!!!!

reviews.author: MostlyPeaceful JC
reviews.text: Every time I've had an issue, Mr. Parrish has either answered or called me back immediately. They came and diagnosed the problem and fixed it quickly. I wish every business I dealt with operated like this one.

reviews.author: Vic
reviews.text: We have used Cliff Parrish twice now for when issues with our HVAC have come up. He’s always been prompt and friendly and the techs are always friendly and helpful. He will be our go-to for any of our future needs or maintenance. If you’re in need of HVAC services, you can’t go wrong with this family owned business.

reviews.author: Pember Wood
reviews.text: If I could give Cliff Parrish Heating & Cooling Services 10 stars, I absolutely would! After the storms this week, the blower fan on one of our HVAC units went out. I reached out to Cliff because he has always taken such great care of us at my workplace, and once again, he went above and beyond. After 9:00 PM, Cliff spent over an hour on the phone with my husband patiently walking him through troubleshooting, explaining what to check, and helping narrow down the possible causes. Who does that these days? Once they determined the blower fan had most likely failed, Cliff assured us that Ronnie Ray would be at our home first thing the next morning. True to his word, Ronnie arrived bright and early, confirmed the diagnosis, replaced the blower fan, and had our AC back up and running in no time. This level of service wasn’t a one-time experience either. At my workplace, Cliff and his team have come to our rescue multiple times, often during the hottest days of summer, when we’ve had HVAC emergencies. They are consistently responsive, knowledgeable, honest, and truly care about their customers. It’s rare to find a company with this level of integrity and customer service. Cliff and his team don’t just fix HVAC systems, they genuinely take care of people. I cannot recommend Cliff Parrish Heating & Cooling Services highly enough. Thank you, Cliff, Ronnie Ray, and the entire team for always going the extra mile!

reviews.author: Eileen
reviews.text: Cliff and technicians are always pleasant and exceed my expectations. Only Cliff Parrish Heating and Cooling for me. They are my heroes

reviews.author: Amy Woodard
reviews.text: I could not have asked for a better experience than what I received. My A/C went out at night and I called first thing the next morning and Mr Cliff had someone at my house so fast. The repairman was nice and very fast. Didn’t take him long to figure out the problem and have me all fixed up. Would absolutely recommend Cliff Parrish and will for sure call him again with any future issues I have.

reviews.author: Nathalia Parrish
reviews.text: Cliff and his crew were amazing to work with! They were professional, polite, and honest. Highly recommend them.
